board_info.description: Combined CPU and driver board covering all Williams System 11 variants (11A/11B/11C). All firmware-relevant circuits (PIA addresses, switch matrix, solenoid drives, lamp matrix, CPU bus) verified identical across variants from schematic comparison. Net name references in this file are schematic-grid-specific and may differ between game schematics while representing the same functional signal.

solenoid_enable_architecture.description: Four 7408 AND-gate arrays (U17â€“U20) qualify solenoid drive signals using two distinct gating domains: PB-driven logic (U17/U18) and U28-latched logic (U19/U20). BLANKING is not used as an input in this AND-matrix.

U28.notes: Provides the latched solenoid bits (1Qâ€“8Q) used by U19/U20. 1A2 (Solenoid Drives bus) is a separate qualifier used by U17/U18.

key_points: BLANKING is not an input to U17, U18, U19, or U20.
The Solenoid Drives bus (1A2) is the qualifier for PB-driven solenoids (U17/U18).
The 1B4 strobe is the qualifier for U28-latched solenoids (U19/U20).
This architecture cleanly separates immediate PB-driven solenoids from latched solenoids.

cmos_memory_protect_subsystem.description: Simple protection of CMOS RAM during reset using RESET-driven chip enable; no dedicated write-protect logic.

behavior.reset_protection: During RESET, CE is forced inactive so CMOS is not accessed while power stabilizes.

platform_variants.overview: Williams System 11 spans three board revisions (11A, 11B, 11C) across 1986-1991. All firmware-relevant circuits are identical across variants. Schematic part numbers do not align with the 11A/11B/11C collector taxonomy.
platform_variants.taxonomy_note: The 11A/11B/11C designations are collector/hobbyist terms. Williams used continuous schematic revision numbers. D-11391 aligns with what collectors call 11A; D-11882 covers both 11B and 11C. No schematic numbered D-11392 has been located -- that number was an error in early JSON versions of this file.

System_11A.firmware_differences_vs_11B: None identified. All PIA addresses, port assignments, CPU bus signals, and decode logic verified identical.
System_11A.board_notes: Earlier physical revision. Same 6808 CPU, same PIA complement, same solenoid/lamp/switch architecture.

System_11B.firmware_differences_vs_11A: None identified. Verified identical to 11A via schematic comparison.
System_11B.board_notes: Physical boards may carry manufacturing part numbers such as D-11883-553. Schematic reference D-11882 confirmed on Space Station, Cyclone, Taxi, Rollergames.

System_11C.firmware_differences_vs_11B: None identified. Schematic part number identical to 11B (D-11882). Verified identical via Diner schematic comparison.
System_11C.board_notes: Later revision. Third ROM socket added in some 11C titles. No PIA, address decode, or bus differences relevant to monitor firmware.
System_11C.rom_note: Some 11C titles use a third EPROM socket. Does not affect capture or decode.
